profile.name: 化学气相沉积（CVD）工艺控制台
profile.description: 用于控制化学气相沉积（CVD）反应器的物理控制台。设备面向薄膜沉积实验，包含多路气体流量通道（用于独立控制多种进气）、温度加热/设定功能、工艺配方的保存与加载、启停工艺的机械/电子控制，以及实时过程曲线显示与监控。用于在受控气体和温度条件下按配方执行沉积工艺并记录关键过程参数。
profile.description_en: Physical control console for a chemical vapor deposition (CVD) reactor used to deposit thin films. The system provides multiple gas flow channels (independent control of several input gases), temperature/heater setpoint control, facilities to save and load process recipes, start/stop execution of recipes, and real‑time plotting/monitoring of process variables. Used to run and monitor deposition recipes under controlled gas and temperature conditions.
